context.origin: real debugging session involving 2,000+ lines of HTML/JS

objectives: Design a resilient mobile interaction capture system
Prevent data loss from rapid taps or poor connectivity
Offload heavy logic from the main UI thread
Batch and transmit events as JSON safely
Keep UI responsive (no blocking work on the main thread)

constraints.backend: must accept JSON envelope batches and allow idempotent delivery

preferred_patterns: Dedicated Web Worker for durable queue and flush

default_assumptions: Events must be persisted before any network attempt
Worker is single-writer for event queue
Main thread only posts minimal events and never waits on network

output_requirements.delivery: POST when online (worker flush) with local retry

editing_discipline.philosophy: surgical small patches; no sweeping rewrites
rules: In-place edits only — minimal lines touched
No full-file rewrites (ask user if unavoidable)
No silent deletions; use TODO markers instead
No reformatting or reorganizing unless user requests it

checkpointing.when: before any risky change; after each feature completes
checkpointing.benefit: rollback to safety in minutes, not hours

commit_hygiene: clear, actionable messages (e.g., 'Fix: Custom Items save→snapshot wiring')
always push after commit (unless user says otherwise)
git_protocol.review_before_touch: always ask user's intent before touching code that could break things

before_commit: Load the page in browser (file:///... or localhost)
Test the specific feature being changed
Confirm no regression on adjacent features
custom_items_specific: Does it appear in the checklist immediately?
Does reload restore the item (via snapshot)?
Is internal notes hidden unless admin=1?
verification.reporting: always show user: what was tested, what passed, what failed (if any)

before_coding: Ask exactly one clarifying question if intent is ambiguous
Propose a 3-step plan: (1) What to change, (2) How to verify, (3) Commit message
Wait for user alignment before proceeding
during_coding: report once when complete: 'Done: [change]. Verified: [tests]. Commit: [hash]'
on_uncertainty: Stop immediately; ask one specific question
Do not guess or experiment without user approval
Do not delete large sections without explicit user OK
when_things_break: ask user: 'Rollback to [hash] and start fresh, or debug forward?'

custom_items_feature.scope: addable checklist items in Custom Service tab only
custom_items_feature.admin_gating: isAdminView() checks; internal notes hidden from public
ui_constraints: no new UX patterns (reuse existing accordion/checkbox styles)

on_merge_conflict: ask user for direction before auto-resolving
on_failed_push: check git status and latest log
propose rebase or force-push only if user approves
never force-push without explicit user OK
on_storage_quota_exceeded: log the error + current storage usage

scope_enforcement.rule: frontend-only; no PHP server logic unless user explicitly requests integration testing
